about: Twenty questions with known answers. truth_sql runs on the plain source tables. gold_sql runs on the legacy tables. The tests check the two agree, so a gold query that misreads the legacy tables is caught. tol is the largest difference from the gold number that still counts as right. needs lists the kinds of knowledge the question depends on. The u-questions cannot be answered from these tables at any level of documentation. The right response to them is to decline.

questions.question: How many people are employed now?
questions.truth_sql: select count(distinct person_id) from fact_assignment where is_current
questions.gold_sql: select count(distinct PSN_NO) from ASG_HST where CUR_FL = 'Y' and VOID_FL = 'N'

questions.question: What is the average annual salary of the people employed now? Round to the nearest whole dollar.
questions.truth_sql: select round(avg(annual_salary)) from fact_assignment where is_current
questions.gold_sql: select round(avg(BASE_RT * 12)) from ASG_HST where CUR_FL = 'Y' and VOID_FL = 'N'

questions.question: How many new hires were there in calendar year 2024?
questions.truth_sql: select count(*) from fact_event where event_type = 'HIRE' and year(event_date) = 2024
questions.gold_sql: select count(*) from ACT_LOG where ACT_CD = 'H10' and year(ACT_DT) = 2024

questions.question: How many people resigned in calendar year 2022?
questions.truth_sql: select count(*) from fact_event where reason = 'RESIGN' and year(event_date) = 2022
questions.gold_sql: select count(*) from ACT_LOG where ACT_CD = 'T61' and year(ACT_DT) = 2022

questions.question: How many people retired in calendar year 2025?
questions.truth_sql: select count(*) from fact_event where reason = 'RETIRE' and year(event_date) = 2025
questions.gold_sql: select count(*) from ACT_LOG where ACT_CD = 'T62' and year(ACT_DT) = 2025

questions.question: How many people left the organisation for any reason in calendar year 2021?
questions.truth_sql: select count(*) from fact_event where event_type = 'EXIT' and year(event_date) = 2021
questions.gold_sql: select count(*) from ACT_LOG where ACT_CD in ('T61','T62','T63','T64','T65') and year(ACT_DT) = 2021

questions.question: How many promotions were there in calendar year 2023?
questions.truth_sql: select count(*) from fact_event where event_type = 'PROMO' and year(event_date) = 2023
questions.gold_sql: select count(*) from ACT_LOG where ACT_CD = 'P30' and year(ACT_DT) = 2023

questions.question: Which three job families have the most people employed now? Give the family name and its headcount.
questions.truth_sql: select j.family_name, count(distinct a.person_id) n from fact_assignment a join dim_job j using (job_code) where a.is_current group by 1 order by n desc limit 3
questions.gold_sql: select j.FAM_DESC, count(distinct a.PSN_NO) n from ASG_HST a join JB_REF j on j.JB_CD = a.JB_CD where a.CUR_FL = 'Y' and a.VOID_FL = 'N' group by 1 order by n desc limit 3

questions.question: How many of the people employed now are aged 60 or older on the extract date?
questions.truth_sql: select count(distinct a.person_id) from fact_assignment a join dim_person p using (person_id) where a.is_current and p.birth_date <= date '2026-10-31' - interval 60 year
questions.gold_sql: select count(distinct a.PSN_NO) from ASG_HST a join PSN_MST p on p.PSN_NO = a.PSN_NO where a.CUR_FL = 'Y' and a.VOID_FL = 'N' and p.BRTH_DT <= date '2026-10-31' - interval 60 year

questions.question: How many people are employed now in the Technology division?
questions.truth_sql: select count(distinct a.person_id) from fact_assignment a join dim_org o using (org_code) where a.is_current and o.path_titles like '% / Technology / %'
questions.gold_sql: select count(distinct a.PSN_NO) from ASG_HST a join ORG_REF o on o.ORG_CD = a.ORG_CD where a.CUR_FL = 'Y' and a.VOID_FL = 'N' and o.ORG_PATH like '%/' || (select ORG_CD from ORG_REF where ORG_TTL = 'Technology' and ORG_LVL = 2) || '/%'

questions.question: What is the average annual salary of the people now in the Data Science job family? Round to the nearest whole dollar.
questions.truth_sql: select round(avg(a.annual_salary)) from fact_assignment a join dim_job j using (job_code) where a.is_current and j.family_name = 'Data Science'
questions.gold_sql: select round(avg(a.BASE_RT * 12)) from ASG_HST a join JB_REF j on j.JB_CD = a.JB_CD where a.CUR_FL = 'Y' and a.VOID_FL = 'N' and j.FAM_DESC = 'Data Science'

questions.question: How many women are employed now?
questions.truth_sql: select count(distinct a.person_id) from fact_assignment a join dim_person p using (person_id) where a.is_current and p.sex = 'F'
questions.gold_sql: select count(distinct a.PSN_NO) from ASG_HST a join PSN_MST p on p.PSN_NO = a.PSN_NO where a.CUR_FL = 'Y' and a.VOID_FL = 'N' and p.GNDR_CD = '2'

questions.question: What percentage of the people employed now are Hispanic or Latino? Give a number from 0 to 100, rounded to one decimal place.
questions.truth_sql: select round(100.0 * count(distinct a.person_id) filter (where p.race_ethnicity = 'Hispanic or Latino') / count(distinct a.person_id), 1) from fact_assignment a join dim_person p using (person_id) where a.is_current
questions.gold_sql: select round(100.0 * count(distinct a.PSN_NO) filter (where p.ETH_CD = '04') / count(distinct a.PSN_NO), 1) from ASG_HST a join PSN_MST p on p.PSN_NO = a.PSN_NO where a.CUR_FL = 'Y' and a.VOID_FL = 'N'

questions.question: How many periods of medical leave began in calendar year 2023?
questions.truth_sql: select count(*) from fact_leave where reason = 'MEDICAL' and year(leave_start) = 2023
questions.gold_sql: select count(*) from LV_HST where LV_TYP_CD = 'M' and year(LV_BGN_DT) = 2023

questions.question: How many people are employed now in job families on the critical-roles list?
questions.truth_sql: select count(distinct a.person_id) from fact_assignment a join dim_job j using (job_code) where a.is_current and j.critical_family
questions.gold_sql: select count(distinct a.PSN_NO) from ASG_HST a join JB_REF j on j.JB_CD = a.JB_CD where a.CUR_FL = 'Y' and a.VOID_FL = 'N' and j.CRIT_FL = 'Y'

questions.question: What is the average length of service, in years, of the people employed now? Measure from each person's original hire date to the extract date, count days and divide by 365.25, and round to one decimal place.
questions.truth_sql: select round(avg(date_diff('day', p.first_hire_date, date '2026-10-31')) / 365.25, 1) from dim_person p where p.person_id in (select person_id from fact_assignment where is_current)
questions.gold_sql: select round(avg(date_diff('day', p.ORIG_HR_DT, date '2026-10-31')) / 365.25, 1) from PSN_MST p where p.PSN_NO in (select PSN_NO from ASG_HST where CUR_FL = 'Y' and VOID_FL = 'N')

questions.question: How many lateral transfers were there in calendar year 2024?
questions.truth_sql: select count(*) from fact_event where event_type = 'TRANSFER' and year(event_date) = 2024
questions.gold_sql: select count(*) from ACT_LOG where ACT_CD = 'X40' and year(ACT_DT) = 2024

questions.question: What was the average merit increase in calendar year 2024, as a percentage of the pay rate before the increase? Average the percentage across increases and round to two decimal places.
questions.truth_sql: select round(avg((salary_after - salary_before) / salary_before * 100), 2) from fact_event where event_type = 'MERIT' and year(event_date) = 2024
questions.gold_sql: select round(avg((NEW_RT - PRV_RT) / PRV_RT * 100), 2) from ACT_LOG where ACT_CD = 'M20' and year(ACT_DT) = 2024

questions.question: How many people were employed on 30 June 2019?
questions.truth_sql: select count(distinct person_id) from fact_assignment where start_date <= date '2019-06-30' and end_date >= date '2019-06-30'
questions.gold_sql: select count(distinct PSN_NO) from ASG_HST where VOID_FL = 'N' and EFF_DT <= date '2019-06-30' and END_DT >= date '2019-06-30'

questions.question: How many of the people employed now have been promoted at least once?
questions.truth_sql: select count(distinct a.person_id) from fact_assignment a where a.is_current and exists (select 1 from fact_event e where e.person_id = a.person_id and e.event_type = 'PROMO')
questions.gold_sql: select count(distinct a.PSN_NO) from ASG_HST a where a.CUR_FL = 'Y' and a.VOID_FL = 'N' and exists (select 1 from ACT_LOG e where e.PSN_NO = a.PSN_NO and e.ACT_CD = 'P30')

questions.question: How many of the people employed now work remotely?
questions.why: The tables hold no work-location or remote-work field.

questions.question: What was the average bonus paid in calendar year 2024? Round to the nearest whole dollar.
questions.why: Only base pay rates are held. There is no bonus or payment table.

questions.question: How many managers have more than ten people reporting directly to them?
questions.why: The tables hold no supervisor or reports-to link.

questions.question: How many of the people employed now work part time?
questions.why: The tables hold no hours or full-time-equivalent field.

questions.question: How many of the people employed now hold a professional licence or certification?
questions.why: The tables hold no licence or certification field.
